text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan (Barang-Barang

Kawalan) (No. 3) 2019.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh dari 23 Mei 2019 hingga 7 Jun 2019.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Daging kerbau import (India)

2. Kubis bulat import (Indonesia dan China, tidak termasuk kubis Beijing)

3. Babi hidup

4. Daging babi (perut)

5. Daging babi (daging dan lemak)

Dibuat 15 Mei 2019

[KPDN (PGK) (S) 0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/XXIII]

DATUK SERI SAIFUDDIN NASUTION BIN ISMAIL

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri

dan Hal Ehwal Pengguna

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 3) ORDER 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the Control of Supplies Act 1961

[Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 3) Order 2019.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles for the

period from 23 May 2019 to 7 June 2019.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Imported buffalo meat (India)

2. Imported round cabbage (Indonesia and China, not including Beijing

cabbage)

3. Live pig

4. Pork (belly)

5. Pork (lean and fat)

Made 15 May 2019

[KPDN (PGK) (S) 0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/XXIII]

DATUK SERI SAIFUDDIN NASUTION BIN ISMAIL

Minister of Domestic Trade

and Consumer Affairs
